integrity: The mathematical proof identifies all conditional distributions, proves a density by Jacobian and integrates exactly; the packaged standalone checker independently diagnoses arithmetic and numerical cases.
scientific_limitations: The conditional winning probability depends on a fifteen-type flat Dirichlet ballot prior, allowing truncated rankings. It is not a universal or empirical election forecast; the full-ranking comparison uses a different prior universe. Formula given for three strictly ordered first-choice shares; independent audit not performed.
title: An exact quartic residual-risk law for first-choice-only instant-runoff polls
